narration: Local Kokoro ONNX af_heart, American English; measured phrase cues; approved intro, nearby and closing audio reused.
sources: All application visuals are fresh redesigned application captures with fictional restaurant records and authentic public nearby listings captured during the refresh. Only the approved kitchen opening/closing visuals and intro, nearby and closing audio are reused. Public listings do not prove supplier suitability, current stock or delivery capability. No real-time execution-speed claim.

scenes.title: Five sections. One clear workflow.
phrases: Five sections organise your work:
Today, Purchases, Suppliers, Menu, and Reports.

Review the ingredients, quantities and units, then approve your menu.

scenes.title: Suppliers / Find nearby businesses
phrases: Find nearby food businesses inside QuotePlate. Choose your area, category and distance. These are real public map listings, with contact details when available. Coverage varies. Check products and delivery capability before adding a supplier.

phrases: Review each supplier’s offer: quantities, taxes, freight and delivery terms.

Save your reason and the accepted decision.

If the restaurant corrects a record, earlier confirmation becomes outdated.
